newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian postmen become police informers.
newsitem.headline: Belgian postmen become police informers.

text.p: Belgian police have begun using postmen as informers to help cut down on crime, a police official said on Thursday.
The project has been launched in four towns and police may also cooperate with foresters and bus drivers, the official told BRTN radio.
"The idea is that...people who are out there in the streets professionally notify police when they see anything suspicious," he said.
"We are extra eyes, extra ears, because postmen go everywhere," said a post office official in the town of Tienen.
